pins.title: Northern Neck vs Outer Banks: Which Shore Fits Your Weekend?
pins.description: Northern Neck vs Outer Banks, compared fairly. The Outer Banks is a great trip; the Northern Neck is under 3 hours from DC, quieter, and shallow enough to wade into from shore.
pins.altText: A single-story cottage with a screened porch under tall trees and a blue sky.

pins.title: Outer Banks Alternative from DC: A Shorter Waterfront Drive
pins.description: Looking for an Outer Banks alternative from DC? Virginia's Northern Neck is under 3 hours away, which matters a lot more with kids in the back seat.
pins.altText: A wooden staircase leading down to a long dock over a calm, sunlit creek.

pins.title: Quiet Chesapeake Weekend Without the Beach Crowds
pins.description: A quiet Chesapeake weekend without the beach crowds: a sheltered tidal creek, a private dock, and a hot tub for stargazing, under 3 hours from Washington DC.
pins.altText: Top half: a cottage with a screened porch under tall trees. Bottom half: a staircase and dock over still creek water.
